description: A man in a flat cap and dark overcoat raises a small black rangefinder camera with a chrome lens to his eye, in a dim, lamp-lit city street. Behind him are a vintage car with its headlamp on, pedestrians in hats and long coats, and shopfronts with glowing windows. The painting is an oil-style night scene that fills the frame edge to edge, with blurred shop signs that show no readable letters.
